claims: Dunkin' Rewards members can use promo code STILLNOTAJOKE in the Dunkin' app for a free hot or iced coffee of any size to celebrate April Fools' Day on April 1, 2026.
The Dunkin' STILLNOTAJOKE promo code offer is limited to one per user while supplies last.
Promo code STILLNOTAJOKE is valid for seven days after activation in the Dunkin' app.
Dunkin' Rewards membership is free to join.
The Dunkin' STILLNOTAJOKE promo code offer is valid in the Dunkin' app on April 1, 2026 for one million users.
